description: This file defines the `Date` class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods to create and manipulate Excel date serials, particularly the `fromYMD` method for constructing dates from year, month, and day inputs. It includes logic for handling various input formats and edge cases, integrating with shared date helper functions.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: Provides methods to create Excel date serials from year, month, and day inputs, with support for various formats and error handling.

methods.name: fromYMD
methods.description: Creates an Excel date serial number from given year, month, and day inputs, accepting array and scalar inputs, with internal validation and adjustment logic.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Converts diverse year representations into an integer, considering the Excel calendar base year and handling special cases.

methods.name: getMonth
methods.description: Converts various month representations (including string names) into an integer (1-12).

methods.name: getDay
methods.description: Converts various day representations into an integer (1-31).

methods.name: adjustYearMonth
methods.description: Adjusts the year and month values to handle cases where month is outside the 1-12 range, modifying year accordingly.
